audit: Independent visual cross-review of 31 pre-existing graph choice/matching questions, years 2019–2022
reviewer: convert_2017 subagent; independent of the original conversion of these 31 questions
method: Rendered every local source task and solution PDF page; visually viewed source pages beside every referenced PNG.
Compared original printed option order and selected answer/matching labels with current answer arrays and solution text.
Inspected actual prompt and part node order using client question.prompt then current part.prompt then answer candidate display.
Viewed every final repaired crop; did not equate file presence or hashing with content verification.
For all 25 questions having Aufgabenpool references, viewed cached live HTTP 200 official PDF question pages and compared printed ID, actual graphics/data/options.
notableRepairs: 2020-ht-t1-18: re-cropped five clipped graph options; corrected answer indices [0,3] to [0,4] for the retained column-major image order and synchronized solution/alt text with printed answer.
Restored four entirely missing given figures in 2020-nt1 t1-04,13,17,19.
Replaced five wrong given PNGs that showed answer tables instead of the actual given graph/diagram: 2022-wt t1-18/19, 2019-nt2 t1-14, 2020-nt2 t1-13, 2022-ht t1-05.
2022-wt-t1-19: histogram restored; six original boxplot alternatives supplied individually, correcting a previously inaccurate textual alternative.
2022-het-t1-08: split the original six graph candidates into matching options after the task instruction, removing the whole-table image from shared givens.
2019-nt2-t1-07: re-cropped all six candidate graphs to restore clipped edges/labels; 2019-nt2-t1-19: restored indispensable series legend, chart title and source.
2021-ht-t2-01: copied only original shared a/b context into independent a2/b2; a2 now contains its required graph.
Corrected inaccurate image descriptions and missing vector arrows while preserving official numeric data and option ordering.
limits: This is a visual and graph-answer audit of the specified 31 existing questions, not a claim that all older archive content has been re-reviewed.
Six records have no Aufgabenpool reference; this review did not infer missing pool IDs.
One date-label difference for the otherwise identical 2020-ht-t1-18 source/pool question is explicitly recorded below.
The old full-table PNG for 2022-het-t1-08 remains on disk but is no longer referenced; no unrelated files were deleted.
